'''Yazhen Plot''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Yazhen and a higher chance of Thorny Yazhen.|A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Yazhen. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.}}
